title: Focal Length
description: How focal length controls field of view, perspective compression, and storytelling distance.
summary: Focal length is the optical distance that determines field of view and perspective; professionals choose it to control subject size, background compression, and viewer intimacy.

knowledgeItem.title: Focal Length
knowledgeItem.description: How focal length controls field of view, perspective compression, and storytelling distance.
definitions: Focal length is the optical distance that determines field of view and perspective; professionals choose it to control subject size, background compression, and viewer intimacy.
rules: If intimacy is the goal, prefer longer or closer framing with controlled perspective.
Always keep matching shots within a coherent focal-length family.
When space is tight, change lens before distorting talent with extreme wide close-ups.
Never treat focal length as interchangeable with digital zoom.
bestPractices: Choose focal length for perspective, not only for framing tightness.
Keep dialogue coverage on complementary focal lengths for continuity.
Use longer lenses to isolate product heroes; wider lenses to establish space.
Account for sensor crop when translating reference looks.

Note focal lengths on the shot list.
